pages.text: Hammer accepts the same mining traits as Pickaxe, plus larger Broad Touch areas.$(br2)$(#55FFFF)Broad Touch I$() (2 slots) — $(item)Slime Ball$()$(br)5×5 mining (not 3×3).$(br2)$(#55FFFF)Broad Touch II$() (4 slots) — same item$(br)3×3 / 5×5 / 7×7 / 9×9 modes.

All $(l:traits/pickaxe_traits)Pickaxe mining traits$() work on hammer, including $(l:traits/crushing_traits)Crushing$() and $(l:traits/ancient_traits)Ancient$(): Speedy, Silky, Autosmelt, Momentum, Moonlit, Frenzy, Scholar, Magnetic, Scavenger, Bountiful, Sustaining, Purifying, Swiftstep, Bulwark, Soulbound, Modifiable.$(br2)$(#FF5555)Not allowed:$() Poison, Freezy, Sharpy, Titan, Ranger.
